title: Wedding & Shower Board
seo_title: Wedding Charcuterie Board for 20–30: Shopping List & Plan
description: A wedding or bridal shower charcuterie board for 20–30: six cheeses, five meats with salami roses, honeycomb, figs, berries and grissini on a marble table.
hook: Elegant abundance for 20 to 30 guests: a photo-ready table with whole brie wheels, salami roses and honeycomb.
why: Large tables fail in a way nobody expects: guests can only eat what they can reach. This board is laid out so every cheese and meat appears more than once along the table, with crackers in several clusters, so nobody crowds one end.
Salami roses and standing grissini give it height and the wow factor for photos, and a range of six cheeses from mild brie to Gorgonzola dolce means there's something for every guest.

timeline.what: Take out all the cheeses; set out every ingredient.
Place the cheese anchors and bowls.
Add the meats and salami roses.
Add the fruit, nuts and garnish.
Stand the grissini, add rosemary and do a final check.

faq.q: How much charcuterie for a wedding?
faq.a: As an appetizer before dinner, plan about 2 oz each of cheese and meat per guest. As the main food, plan 3 to 4 oz each.

faq.q: Can I make a wedding grazing table ahead?
faq.a: Cut the hard cheeses and make the salami roses the day before. Assemble within an hour of guests arriving and refill from the fridge. Leave it out no more than 2 hours, or 1 hour above 90°F.

faq.q: How do you keep a big table from getting crowded?
faq.a: Repeat each cheese and meat at both ends and put crackers in several clusters so guests can approach from every side.
